notes.title: Free demo now available!
notes.content: [h2][b]The demo for the roguelite × puzzle game Dialoop -Roguelite Puzzle- is now available on Steam as of Wednesday, September 24, 2025![/b][/h2][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3987520/Dialoop__Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]In the demo, you can play the core mode of the game: “Solo Survival”! [/p][p]Enjoy the unique randomness of roguelite gameplay and the strategic depth that only puzzles can offer. [/p][p][/p][p]Additionally, a major update planned for October will introduce the online multiplayer mode, “Arena”! [/p][p]Look forward to competing with friends and players from around the world in this exciting new mode. [/p][p][/p][p]A video where the developers provide an in-depth explanation of Dialoop -Roguelite Puzzle- is also available![/p][previewyoutube="XI5mO3qf2CE;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Demo Release Date Confirmed!
notes.content:
[h3]Everyone, thank you for waiting![/h3][p][/p][h2][b]The demo release date for Dialoop -Roguelite Puzzle- has been set for Thursday, September 24!![/b][/h2][h2][b]At the same time, the Steam demo page is now live.[/b][/h2][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3987520/Dialoop__Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]In the demo, you can play the core mode of the game: [b]“Solo Puzzle”[/b]!
Enjoy the unique strategy and addictive gameplay that only a roguelite × puzzle game can offer.[/p][p][/p][p]Additionally, a major update planned for October will add an [b]online multiplayer mode, “Puzzle Together”[/b]!
Look forward to competing with friends and players from around the world in this new mode.[/p][p][/p][p]Be sure to try the demo and experience the world of roguelite × puzzle![/p][p][/p][p]A video where the developers thoroughly explain [b]Dialoop -Roguelite Puzzle-[/b] is also available!
Check it out here: ↓[/p][previewyoutube="XI5mO3qf2CE;full"][/previewyoutube]
